title: Thread compounds.
officialText:
Thread (joint) compounds (pipe dope) shall be resistant to the action of liquefied petroleum gas or to
any other chemical constituents of the gases to be conducted through the piping. Use of cotton thread (lamp wick) is prohibit ed.
